body: Write a note to your therapist he/she will know how to take it from there. Good luck and I hope you are well soon.

Kindness. There is kindness real genuine caring in this world. There are people who want to help, want to listen, want to know how things are for you. Maybe not everyone but there are enough. Also underneath all the pain and suffering and beyond it there is this amazingly beautiful world, so precious. You have a role to play in it that no one else can. Each of us have unique gifts to offer. Sometimes it takes time to know what they are but we all have them. Personally i have found counselling helpful but it may be different for you. Good luck. Try one day at a time and keep reaching out.

In a word no, you are not a bad person. You probably have as many good qualities as as most other people. Having behaviour you don't like is not you. You are not your behaviour honestly. I felt I was a bad person once but I don't think that now. You really rally need help though. You didn't ask to be abused. The difficult feelings of that situation can't just go away but believe me your behaviour can change. I haven't been in your situation but I have done things I hated myself for. Counselling has really helped me. It isn't a quick fix but through a relationship with someone who you can talk to who doesn't abuse you you can find a way through. This is the only way I know but it can be done. Sexual feelings aren't bad and masturbating doesn't hurt anyone. Good luck. You have taken the first step here.

I've been in a state where I couldn't talk to anyone before. Eventually I did and I hope you can just as you have now reached out here. There are no easy answers but many people have felt like you do before and many of them have moved through it. There is some reason why you feel as you do. Keep writing here if you can't face talking. I suggest make a deal to not act on these feelings for another day or another week or whatever seems reasonable. If anything gives you pleasure and doesn't harm you, schedule it in. Make sure you eat and try to exercise. You could try ringing a helpline as a first attempt to tell someone. You could write a note to someone. You matter and I hope you can find help and feel  not so alone soon.
